22. Why is multiple inheritance not permitted through Java classes?
Multiple inheritance means a class would inherit from more than one parent class.
The issue identified is that this can lead to ambiguity or confusion when the same members are available through multiple parent classes.
Therefore, multiple inheritance is not permitted through Java classes.
